QUOTE: Two routes, and the compile-time one wins when both are present.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer separates compile-time macros from the runtime setter, but it says the compile-time route wins when both are present and the runtime setter is "compiled out". It never says the two are mutually exclusive, and it doesn't clearly present them as a macro pair versus a function-pointer pair that can't be combined.
